title: feat(nm2oricyclrdz): neighbor-read of cyclic lex-largest Orient at t+1 on two-axis opposite z-probes: reverse fails, face fails
science: THE band's forcing negative: at the headline cell (opposite z-probes, cyclic lex-largest) the neighbour-read of the orientation fails at ALL FOUR probes. Recomputation shows why - every probe is ANTI-aligned with every 6-neighbour whose Orient is defined. The handedness that agrees across the L1-distance-2 probe pairs has zero support at distance 1.
